name: Fleeting Flight
oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying until end of turn. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.

needs.what: a combat-only form of the one-shot `prevent_damage_permanent` op (e.g. `combat_only: true` beside `dealt: "to"` and `duration: "this_turn"`), installed on the spell's target at resolution, that prevents combat damage dealt to that permanent this turn while letting noncombat damage through
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` takes only objects, dealt and duration and its shield stops all damage, combat and noncombat (a strictly better card); `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` static, which lives on a printed permanent and cannot be installed on a target by a resolving spell; the `grant_ability` op grants only triggered or activated abilities, not a static. The first two sentences are expressible (add_counters +1/+1 on the target, grant_keyword flying until end of turn)
